text:
Anna: quick heads-up — ran cross-region perf sweep for qwen-70b q4 (onboard quant) comparing h100 us-west vs mi300 eu-central. found a sharp latency divergence at long contexts (>= 6k).

Mike: pasted the 3-run median numbers below (cold KV cache, single-stream tokens):
```
Model | HW (region) | seq | p95 latency (ms) | throughput (tokens/s)
Qwen-70B q4 | H100 (us-west) | 2048 | 220 | 4200
Qwen-70B q4 | MI300 (eu-central) | 2048 | 260 | 3800
Qwen-70B q4 | H100 (us-west) | 8192 | 650 | 1500
Qwen-70B q4 | MI300 (eu-central) | 8192 | 1200 (!) | 800
```

Mike: note the MI300 p95 at 8192 is ~2x H100 and throughput drops ~47%. CPU sidechains look fine.

Sophia: hmm this smells like a kernel fallthrough for long-rope/GQA handling. qwen's rope implementation uses phased scaling that some mi kernels don't vectorize — leads to extra synchronizations. saw similar in a100->h100 in past but reversed.

Ravi: can you dump the kernel selection logs for the MI300 run? specifically want to see which attention kernel was chosen and whether we fell back from fused-gqa -> scalar-rope.

Mike: uploaded logs to the perf bucket: https://internal-perf.redwood/sweeps/1809123456/qwen-q4-mi300/logs and snapshot of kernel choices:
```
2026-11-05T14:12:03Z INFO model=qwen-70b kernel=attn_fused_gqa_mi300_fast
2026-11-05T14:12:03Z WARN model=qwen-70b fallback=rope_phase_scalar because seq_len>=8192 and hw=mi300
2026-11-05T14:12:03Z INFO kernel_switch reason=quant_kernel_mismatch
```

Elaine: ah — "quant_kernel_mismatch" indicates the compiled int8 kernels for MI300 didn't support the ROPE unwinding vector path. runtime falls back to a scalar path that is O(n^2) expensive per token for long seqs.

Sophia: short checklist: 1) confirm kernel ABI mismatch 2) recompile fused-gqa with rope-phase support for mi300 3) run microbench of only attn kernel at seq 8192 4) add guard in routing so eu region uses fallback smaller seqs until fixed.

Anna: flagged as ENG-ML-1123 and assigned to eng-runtime to recompile. Also opened a temporary routing policy so that any qwen-70b requests from eu-central with seq>4096 get routed to H100 pool.

Infra-bot: Deploy scheduled: route-fix-qwen-eu (canary) -> 2026-11-05T16:00:00Z :white_check_mark:

Ravi: I'll run the microbench on mi300 tomorrow morning and post flame graphs. If we confirm kernel deficiency, should we prioritize a hotpatch compile or add a quant-profile that disables the problematic kernel?

Sophia: hotpatch compile preferred if it's small; fallback quant-profile as safety net. also add a regression eval set with long-context prompt suite so this doesn't slip through.

Mike: one more detail — Llama & Mistral runs on same sweep didn't show the same degradation on MI300 (they use different rope handling), so this is Qwen-specific. added comparison csv to bucket.

Anna: plan for next 48h:
- Ravi: microbench + flamegraphs (EU MI300) — due +24h
- Eng-runtime: attempt mi300 compile with rope vectors + test on CI — due +36h
- Product/Platform: maintain temporary routing until we have a kernel fix or acceptable perf — done by +12h
- Sophia: add long-context regression eval to CI (eval set + thresholds) — due +48h

Elaine: adding notes to the model onboarding doc about kernel compatibility table (hw vs rope/gqa support). link: https://confluence.redwood/model-onboarding/kernel-compat

Anna: thanks all. keeping this thread for updates. feel free to @channel if it becomes a customer-impacting regression.
